text:
Cloud cost is running 47.5% above its baseline (high severity). The increase began at 2026-09-22 10:00 UTC and was detected at 2026-09-22 12:00 UTC.

The likely root cause is location-service (root-cause confidence 95%). Its own behaviour changed, and the extra load spread along location-service -> redis, location-service -> event-queue, event-queue -> analytics. The next candidate, api-gateway (33%), was ruled out: its load rose x2.60, but it only forwards user traffic; the extra requests belong to the services behind it. Estimated impact traced to location-service: $6,658/month.

Supporting evidence:
- User requests rose x3.00 (91,728 → 274,734 per minute)
- Deployed v5.2 1h before its own behaviour changed
- Accounts for 100% of the estimated cost increase through the services it calls
- Total calls to redis rose x3.00
- Total calls to event-queue rose x2.99
- Its change tracks the total cost curve (correlation 0.99)
- 1 similar past incident on record

Recommended: Rate-limit location-service to 1.2x baseline traffic. Estimated saving $6,138/month, latency +0.0%, error rate +0.0pp, risk medium. Not recommended: Reduce database capacity 25%, because latency +13% > +10% limit.
